edges: Louise and Renée become close friends during their novitiate at the Carmelite convent of Blois.
Renée marries Louis, an older man of little wealth or standing.
Louise confides her feelings of despair to Renée.
Renée rushes to inform Louise of the truth about Marie's situation.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Felipe and Louise live a life of carefree happiness.
Louise suspects Marie of having an expensive mistress.
